info.name: Settings API - Full Documentation
info.description: Postman collection for System Settings API module including Auth login, Get Settings, and Update Settings endpoints aligned with SystemSettingSeeder.

request.description: Authenticate user to obtain Sanctum/Bearer access token.
Fetch key-value map of all system settings. Requires 'Setting Index' permission.
